Perhaps the biggest reason why free-speech sites tend to lean right is because pretty much any time free speech is challenged, right-wing speech is amongst the first to go, at least as far as the Internet age goes. Given the significance of free speech, people will seek out forums where they can properly express their dialog without fear of censorship by the forum in question. And since the left has many more outlets to freely express themselves, they have little reason to shift their discussions elsewhere. Thus, as time goes on, the people who will stick with true-free speech forums will be a combination of those who would be censored first, and those who are concerned that their speech could be next, or at the very least further down the road.

The reason why infiltration occurs when a site expands tends to occur in phases. The first step is when a site grows. In order to maintain a site's growth, certain members of the community will try to make newcomers feel welcome. As the pool of people expands, the list of things that make people feel unwelcome expands as well. Thus, the site owners have to make a decision to maintain rigidity of site culture, or start censoring things in order to assist in the integration of more newcomers. The former decision leads to places like here, at least up to and including this point in time. The latter tends to lead towards a spiral. As the people in power bend the knee, the perpetually outraged will further push the goal lines to get them to bend harder. At some point during this step, you start to see either already-existing moderators start to lean hard-left, or new ones that already are come in. This is effectively the point of no return for anyone concerned with free speech. Rule enforcement becomes incredibly inconsistent in their favor, as the moderation and administration teams start to stack the deck in the favor of those who would have heavily-censored discussion. Eventually, what right-leaning mods/admins may remain either resign are forced out, and the site effectively becomes a hugbox, where only one type of view is allowed, assisted by many disdainful dissenters leaving for greener pastures, bringing me back to the previous paragraph.

Long story short, never give an inch.
